scope: Bounded AC1027 DXF SUNSTUDY repeated conversion after explicit whole-DXF source observation; no broader DWG or native rendering claim.

source.author: tools/audit_sunstudy_dxf_graph.py author
source.provenance: Locally authored scratch DXF; the repeat input is generated by the current writer. The test adds no fixture.

profile: One SUNSTUDY with exactly one same-owner reactor; accepts both exact reactor-before-owner and owner-before-reactor raw orders. The source NOD is either the original one-entry profile or an ordered two-entry profile containing the unique study-owner edge and ACAD_GROUP soft-owner edge. The latter must bind an unchanged uniquely owned empty GROUP dictionary to its same-import raw and typed source snapshots; only the exact four-group empty representation or the five-group representation with explicit 280=0 qualifies. Existing authenticated whole-source CLASS, source text, source generation, graph, target-revision and budgets remain in force.
emission_proof: The decoded staged OBJECTS proof checks the unique SUNSTUDY, NOD, study-owner and generated GROUP identities, both NOD soft-owner edges, the study-owner edge, study owner/reactor and payload, and the empty GROUP owner and contents. It does not qualify unrelated objects or whole-file interoperability.

validation.cli_result: 26 focused controls passed: ASCII/Binary second and third conversion, independent ASCII graph inspection, source GROUP owner/edge role/target, unknown-field and nonempty mutations with atomic refusal and corrected retries; default, target and original-source strict gates still apply.
validation.adapter_result: 2/2 passed: both encodings, fresh repeated-source import, eight root/GROUP identity, role, ownership and content mutations, late root mutation, destination preservation and same-exporter retries, plus whole-source budget controls.
validation.addressSanitizer: ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R '^dwg2dxf_sunstudy_dxf_graph$' --output-on-failure: 1/1 passed for the successor adapter.

limits: No external producer or native renderer test is added. Other SUNSTUDY graphs, arbitrary class rows, nonempty GROUP dictionaries, extra root entries, proxy content and other source or target versions remain unqualified.
